EmailTemplate.name: NZC AEI Data Archival Email Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: Data Archival for AEI
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi ESG Team User,
Your Annual Emissions Inventory record will be deleted after 30 days.
The following are the record details:
Record Name: {!AnnualEmssnInventory.Name} Record Link: {!AnnualEmssnInventory.Link} Archival Date: {!AnnualEmssnInventory.AEI_Archival_Date__c}
In addition to the above record, the following related records will also be deleted:
Stationary Asset Carbon Footprint Stationary Asset Energy Use Vehicle Asset Carbon Footprint Vehicle Asset Energy Use Scope 3 Carbon Footprint Freight Hauling Energy Use Rental Car Energy Use Generated Waste Air Travel Energy Use Hotel Stay Energy Use Ground Travel Energy Use Scope 3 Procurement Summary Waste Footprint Generated Waste (related to Waste Footprint)
**Important Note:** If you do not want your record to be archived, please click on the record link above and check the "Exclude from Archival" checkbox before the archival date.
Thank you, {!AnnualEmssnInventory.LastModifiedBy}
Disclaimer: This is an auto generated email. Please do not reply to this mail.
